prompt: Realistic, but lit like a stage in a dream: thick haze hangs in the air and the light cuts through it in solid visible beams. Camera low at the height of the firebox, fresh banknotes scattered on the stone floor in the foreground. In a hidden 1920s basement print room, a huge cast-iron printing press throws sheets of banknotes into the air. Beside it a tall skinny man in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache, shovels coal into the press's red-hot firebox, grinning. Behind him an exhausted stoker in a soot-black vest sits slumped against the brick wall. Riveted pipes, brass gauges, steam. A hot magenta beam from high left and an ice-blue beam from low right cross on the main figure; dust and smoke drift in the beams; everything outside them falls away to black. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
